$comment: This repository has no published URL yet, so a config's $schema is the repository-relative path schemas/v2/config/data.json; the loader checks that suffix and never dereferences it. Give this file an absolute $id when the repository has a public home.
title: The back-end data store

source.description: A directory, a local .zip, or an http(s) URL. A relative path is resolved against the config file's own directory. ${VAR} is expanded from the environment; an undefined variable is an error rather than an empty string (audit N-17).

checksum.description: The archive's SHA-256. REQUIRED when source is a URL or a .zip — unverified model inputs are not acceptable provenance (docs/decisions/0011-data-fetched-not-vendored.md). Not used for a directory source. The verified archive is extracted once, content-addressed, under the user cache.
